visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts with a close-up of a pair of hands expertly slicing bright red chili peppers into thin rings on a light-colored cutting board. In the blurred background, a red ceramic pot rests on a modern black stovetop in a brightly lit kitchen environment. (2) Transition to a white ceramic bowl where a whole garlic clove is being smashed with a metal meat mallet. The hands then use a large chef's knife to finely mince the crushed garlic into small, uniform pieces on the same cutting board. (3) The hands continue by chopping fresh green cilantro stems and leaves into fine bits, followed by slicing green onions into small rounds. The camera remains in a medium close-up, focusing on the rhythmic and precise knife work of the character. (4) All the prepared aromatics—chili, garlic, cilantro, and green onions—are gathered and placed into the white bowl. A wooden spoon is used to stir the colorful mixture as white pepper and other seasonings are added from small containers. (5) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a pink apron over a purple top, appears. She holds three long, vibrant purple eggplants towards the camera. She then trims the green stems and cuts the eggplants into equal-length cylindrical sections. (6) The eggplant sections are neatly arranged upright in a round metal steamer basket. The woman carries the basket toward the stove, where a wide pan of water is already heating. She adds a pinch of salt to the water. (7) The steamer basket is placed into the pan, and a glass lid is set on top. Steam begins to cloud the glass as the eggplants cook. The woman waits nearby, looking at the camera with a friendly expression. (8) After the specified time, she lifts the lid, and a cloud of steam rises. The eggplants have turned a slightly deeper purple. She carefully removes the steamer basket and shows the perfectly cooked eggplant pieces to the viewer. (9) In a small white pot decorated with pink flowers, oil is heated over a low flame. The woman drops a small piece of red chili into the oil to check if it has reached the desired temperature, watching for bubbles. (10) The hot oil is poured directly over the bowl of aromatics, creating a visible sizzle and release of steam. The woman uses a wooden spoon to stir the mixture quickly, ensuring the flavors of the chili and garlic are infused. (11) Liquid seasonings including soy sauce, oyster sauce, and vinegar are measured into the bowl with a metal spoon. A small amount of sugar is also added. The woman continues to stir the sauce until it is well combined. (12) The woman demonstrates how to tear the cooled eggplant sections into thin vertical strips using her fingers. She meticulously arranges these strips in a neat stack on an elongated white ceramic serving plate. (13) The flavorful aromatic sauce is generously spooned over the arranged eggplant strips. The final dish is vibrant, topped with the red, green, and white bits of the dressing, looking highly appetizing under the bright kitchen lights. (14) The woman takes a small bowl of white rice topped with cilantro and uses chopsticks to pick up a piece of the eggplant. She eats it with a smile, showing her enjoyment of the dish. Social media handles appear at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice begins narrating the cooking steps in Traditional Chinese, accompanied by a bright, medium-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM. The narrator explains the process clearly, her voice exhibiting a warm, professional tone with moderate intensity and a clear articulation. The background music remains upbeat and steady. (3) The sound of the knife continues as cilantro and scallions are chopped. There is a slight shifting sound of objects on a table. The narrator's pitch is stable, and she pauses briefly between instructions, creating a natural and engaging instructional pace. (4) A soft scraping sound is heard as the chopped aromatics are moved into a ceramic bowl. The clinking of a spoon against the side of the bowl accompanies the stirring process. The music's volume is slightly ducked to keep the voice prominent. (5) The narrator introduces the eggplants, and the sound of fabric rustling from her apron is caught as she moves. The knife sounds return, this time with a slightly different resonance as it cuts through the thicker texture of the eggplant skin. (6) Water splashing and the sound of a lid being placed on a metal pot mark the transition to the steaming phase. The ambient room tone is very clean, indicating a studio-quality recording environment with high signal-to-noise ratio. (7) A sudden, loud 'hiss' and 'sizzle' occur as hot oil is poured over the cold aromatics in the bowl. This high-frequency transient event is a key acoustic feature. The narrator's voice rises slightly in pitch to express excitement about the aroma. (8) The clinking of a metal spoon against a glass bottle and then the ceramic bowl is heard as liquid ingredients are added. The narrator maintains a high arousal level, sounding cheerful and encouraging throughout the complex mixing stage. (9) Soft tearing sounds are audible as the eggplant is processed by hand. The music swells slightly in volume during the final plating. The video concludes with the sound of chopsticks clicking and a satisfied vocal reaction ('Mmm!') from the narrator.
